headline: Aye Finance reports Rs 87 crore profit for Q2
hook: Record quarterly profit for Aye Finance
summary: Aye Finance posted a net profit of Rs 87 crore for the quarter ending September 2026. This represents a 151% increase compared to the same period last year and a 16% growth over the previous quarter. The company disclosed these figures in a press release filed with the exchange on October 21, 2026.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings signal operational growth for the lender.
